In addition, if you put in a minimum of 10 hours per week during that time, I promise to hire you full-time as an associate when you pass the bar exam. The law student continued to work for the lawyer throughout the rest of his law school career and while he was studying for the bar exam. D. The lawyer would be required to recognize the validity of the assignment, but would be entitled to demand adequate assurances of performance from the roommate as to the latter's willingness and professional capacity to perform satisfactory work.
E. The lawyer would be required to recognize the validity of the assignment, but only if the roommate can prove he is capable of performing the duties of an associate.
F. The lawyer would not be required to recognize the validity of the assignment, because the original agreement was not intended to be assignable.
